items.title: Prato: Cuscuz de milho + Sardinha (lata, drenada) + Cenoura crua
items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative meal photograph for a nutrition recipe catalog. Primary request: a realistic appetizing serving containing ONLY these named catalog foods (names in Brazilian Portuguese): Cuscuz de milho; Sardinha (lata, drenada); Cenoura crua. Arrange the three foods in adjacent sections in a white ceramic shallow bowl. Respect the named food varieties and preparation states: cozido means boiled/cooked, grelhado grilled, assado roasted, cru raw, sem pele means SKINLESS with all skin removed before cooking. Keep raw vegetables raw. Meat, fish, seafood and egg whites must be fully cooked. Skinless chicken must show bare cooked meat fibers, never a golden skin sheet. Whole boiled eggs have firm yolks. Tofu and seitan are ready to eat. Tapioca goma is prepared as a white cassava crepe; it is not raw powder or a wheat pancake. Supplement powders are mixed into the named liquid, never served as loose powder. Do not invent sauces, herbs, toppings, other fruit or any ingredient that was not named. Whole prepared foods such as bread, pancakes, cheese bread, hummus and granola retain their normal appearance. Remove fruit peels, pits or cores that would not be eaten; do not add ingredient props beside the serving. Variety details when named: Ameixa means fresh juicy plum wedges with smooth purple-red skin and golden flesh, not dried wrinkled prunes; batata baroa is yellow arracacha (mandioquinha), not fibrous cassava; cuscuz marroquino is fine fluffy wheat couscous, not large pearl couscous; edamame is cooked shelled green soybeans, no inedible pods; feijao means the named bean variety, not lentils or chickpeas. Atum fresco grelhado is fully cooked grilled tuna: opaque beige-tan flaky muscle chunks with browned edges, no pink or red center, no rare sliced steaks. Frango coxa sem pele is skinless roasted thigh muscle: serve small irregular shredded fibrous pieces with matte beige flesh and very light browning on a few tips. No intact drumsticks or whole thighs, no glossy orange-brown surface sheets or crust, no skin layered over the meat. Style: realistic editorial food photography with natural food textures. Composition: square 1:1 overhead view, entire vessel fully visible and centered, neutral warm light-gray tabletop, soft natural daylight and gentle realistic shadows.
